book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte

title: Unit summary and review questions
competency: Bring together the ideas of Unit 2.

keywords.def: Personal qualities that help you work well with others, do your job and grow in your career.
The skill of generating new ideas and new ways of working.
The skill of identifying a problem and finding a solution.
Detailed information about a specific person: who they are and what they have.

en.text: Ethiopia has eight CTE areas. Soft skills, like creative thinking and problem solving, help you work well with others alongside technical skills. A personal profile tells who you are, your skills, and your education and experience.

screens.title: Warm up: where does each belong?
Unit summary
paras: Ethiopia has eight CTE areas: manufacturing, agriculture, construction and information technology.
The other four are health sciences, business sciences, language and social sciences, and performing and visual arts.
Soft skills matter for good interaction, along with technical skills.
Creative thinking generates new ideas. Problem solving finds solutions.
A personal profile shows who you are, your skills, likes, education and experience.

screens.title: Key words of the unit
defs: Personal qualities that help you work with others, do your job and grow.
Generating new ideas and new ways of working.
Identifying a problem and finding a solution.
Detailed information about who you are and what you have.

pairs: Turning raw materials into finished goods
Seeing things in a new way
screens.clue: Start with the one you are sure of.

screens.text: Soft skill alone gets you employment.
screens.why: You also need technical skills, knowledge and experience.

screens.text: Non-verbal communication is the use of ___ for telling information.
screens.why: Speaking, writing and talking use words. Non-verbal means without words: gestures and faces.

screens.text: Yonas wants a job in a hotel. Which plan uses the whole unit best?
opts: Learn hotel service skills, build teamwork and communication, and write a short profile
Write a 20-page profile and skip training
screens.ans: Learn hotel service skills, build teamwork and communication, and write a short profile
screens.why: He needs the CTE area's hard skills, soft skills for working with people, and a concise profile for applying.
screens.clue: Think: area skills + soft skills + profile.

items.text: "Sewing is a hard skill for a carpenter." Is it correct?
opts: Incorrect: sewing is a tailor's skill
items.ans: Incorrect: sewing is a tailor's skill

items.text: "Hard skills are universal while soft skills are specific to a job." Is it correct?
opts: Incorrect: soft skills are universal, hard skills are job-specific
items.ans: Incorrect: soft skills are universal, hard skills are job-specific
items.why: The book says soft skills are not job-specific.

items.text: Soft skill alone gets you employment.
items.why: Technical skills, knowledge and experience are needed too.

items.text: Being open-minded is an obstacle for problem solving.
items.why: An open mind helps you compare solutions.

items.text: Innovation and critical thinking are very much related.
items.why: New ideas come from careful, new thinking.
items.clue: Where do new ideas come from?

items.text: Soft skills do not support students to learn.
items.why: Study plans and group work use soft skills.

items.text: ___ skill is specific for a certain job.
Information to be included in a personal profile for a job is:
Non-verbal communication is the use of ___ for telling information.
What information is included in a personal profile? Tap all.
items.why: A profile covers you, your skills, and your education or experience.

notes.text: The chapter test draws 20 questions round-robin from the five section tests (no clues, 25 minutes).
Review I e and II 3 ask about innovation, critical thinking and non-verbal communication, which the unit does not teach; answers come from general knowledge.
Review Part I asks students to correct wrong statements; asked as correct/incorrect with the corrected statement in the options.
Review III ii (critical thinking or solution first) is in lesson 2.2.2.
